messages:
Hana: Heads-up: prepping social assets for the platform launch next week. Need X announcement, LinkedIn long post, and a short tweetstorm tied to the benchmark blog + webinar. Who can own scheduling + paid boost?

Liam: I can own X copy + thread. Will do a 4-tweet thread: hook, stat, quick how, webinar CTA.

Zoe: I'll take LinkedIn long form and a 4-slide carousel. Will pull the benchmark graphic from the figma file.

Hana: Specs: X cards 1200x675, LinkedIn hero 1200x1200. Alt text required. Zoe, use the enterprise angle on slide 3.

Liam: Draft hook tweet: "We cut inference cost by 28% and doubled throughput. Here's how. Webinar Apr 7. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar #LLMops"

Zoe: LinkedIn draft starting now in the doc. Carousel plan: slide1 TL;DR, slide2 benchmark chart, slide3 config tips, slide4 webinar + CTA.

AdOps-bot: Paid boost request created: campaign=benchmark_promo, budget=$300, duration=48h.

Hana: Targeting: US + UK devs, infra leads. Riley please set UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=paid

Riley: UTMs added. Scheduling windows: 09:30 PT and 16:00 GMT. Will queue once final assets land.

Liam: Short reply templates for engagement: "Thanks! We'll send the deck after the webinar. Sign up: https://redwood.ai/webinar" and "Short answer: batching + quantization tweaks. DM for config snippet."

Zoe: Uploaded images + alt text to Figma exports. File: figma.redwood/launch/exports.

Hana: Final owners: X copy & monitoring (Liam), LinkedIn carousel & post (Zoe), scheduling & UTMs (Riley), paid boost (AdOps-bot). Any blockers?

Liam: All good from copy side.

Zoe: Need final headshot for speaker slide. Pinged design.

Hana: Ok aim to queue on Wed AM. Thanks everyone :rocket:
